messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
This is my first new IT cert in two years or more, and now my head is back in the game, with the letters CSSSS posted after my name.

output.original_text: This is my first new IT cert in two years or more, and now my head is back in the game, with the letters CSSSS posted after my name.
output.joy: This is my first new IT cert in two years or more, and I’m thrilled to have my head back in the game, with the letters CSSSS shining proudly after my name!
output.sadness: This is my first new IT cert in two years or more, and I’m trying to feel good about it even though it’s hard to see my head finally back in the game, with the letters CSSSS after my name.
output.fear: This is my first new IT cert in two years or more, and I’m a bit uneasy about having my head back in the game, with the letters CSSSS after my name—it feels like a lot of pressure.
output.anger: This is my first new IT cert in two years or more, and finally, my head is back in the game with the letters CSSSS after my name—it's about time!
output.surprise: This is my first new IT cert in two years or more, and I can't believe my head is back in the game, with the letters CSSSS unexpectedly added after my name!
output.disgust: This is my first new IT cert in two years or more, and I can hardly believe I have to put the letters CSSSS after my name just to prove I’m back in the game.
